page.overview:
Who is Kamelia?

Kamelia was a listener of Darko Draganov.

Kamelia wrote to Darko Draganov asking how many times one should report to the Dune Watch network. He suggested that people should submit reports to the network on a daily basis, encouraging his listeners to report any individuals that they found suspicious.
